name: Microsoft Teams Essentials
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Microsoft Teams Essentials, host small private video rooms and a simple team chat on user-owned infrastructure. The hard boundary is microsoft identity, global media, calendars, files, telephony, admin, and support, plus real-time media infrastructure and reliability.
